title: [test] CLI end-to-end tests in tests/cli.test.ts
acceptance_criteria: New file tests/cli.test.ts. Spins up the Express app on an ephemeral port (app.listen(0)) and points the CLI base URL at it via NOTEAPI_URL. Invokes the CLI (via child process or by importing/calling its main with a captured argv + stdout/stderr/exit) covering: each of the 5 subcommands' happy path (create then read/list/update/delete), --help and -h output + exit 0 (global and per-subcommand), --version and -v printing 'fleet-e2e-toy v1.0.0' + exit 0, and the empty/whitespace required-arg validation error path (stderr message + exit 1, no stack trace). Clears noteStore between tests. All tests pass with npm test and existing tests still pass.

title: [impl] --version/-v flag prints fleet-e2e-toy v1.0.0
acceptance_criteria: In src/cli.ts: cli --version or cli -v prints exactly 'fleet-e2e-toy v1.0.0' to stdout and exits 0. It is checked first, before subcommand dispatch and before validation, so it works whether or not other flags/subcommands are present. Version string may be sourced from package.json version (1.0.0) but the printed prefix is 'fleet-e2e-toy v'.

title: [impl] Input validation: reject missing/empty/whitespace required flags
acceptance_criteria: In src/cli.ts: a required flag that is missing, empty, or whitespace-only (e.g. --title "  ") is rejected with message 'Error: <field> is required and must not be empty' on stderr and exit code 1. Applies to --id (read/update/delete), --title and --content (create). No stack traces reach the console for validation or API failures — all thrown errors are caught and formatted. Validation runs after --version and --help short-circuits.

title: [impl] Help system: global --help/-h and per-subcommand help
acceptance_criteria: In src/cli.ts: running cli --help or cli -h with no subcommand prints top-level usage listing all 5 subcommands (list, read, create, update, delete) to stdout and exits 0. Running <subcommand> --help or <subcommand> -h prints that subcommand's usage (its flags) to stdout and exits 0. Help is resolved before input validation so help never triggers a validation error. Output goes to stdout (not stderr).

title: [impl] CLI foundation: entry point, argv parsing, HTTP client
acceptance_criteria: New file src/cli.ts exists as the CLI entry point. It parses process.argv into a subcommand + a flag map (supporting --flag value form). It exposes a reusable HTTP helper that calls NoteAPI via Node global fetch against a base URL from NOTEAPI_URL env var, defaulting to http://localhost:3000. The helper returns parsed JSON on 2xx; on non-2xx or network failure it produces a formatted { error: <message> } object. A central runner dispatches to subcommand handlers and, on any thrown error, prints { "error": "<message>" } (pretty JSON) to stderr and exits 1 with NO stack trace. Unknown subcommand prints usage to stderr and exits 1. package.json build/tsc still passes and npm run lint is clean. No new runtime dependencies added; no changes to files under src/api or src/utils.

title: sprint: cli-crud-help-version
close_reason: all 10 tasks closed, features integration-tested and closed

title: CLI CRUD commands (list/read/create/update/delete)
description: Implement five subcommands against the NoteAPI: list (optional --tag/--q filter), read (--id required), create (--title, --content required), update (--id required, --title/--content optional), delete (--id required). Each command calls the API and prints results to stdout. Non-zero exit on API error.

title: CLI help system and input validation
description: The CLI must support --help/-h flags globally and per subcommand, printing usage and exiting 0. Input validation must reject empty or whitespace-only arguments with a clear error message and non-zero exit code. No stack traces in error output.

title: Add input validation for empty or blank strings
description: When user passes empty string or whitespace-only string as argument, reject with clear error message. Non-zero exit code. Add unit test. Ref: gh-toy-v6z.

title: Add --version flag to CLI
description: The CLI tool should support a --version (or -v) flag that prints the current version string and exits with code 0. Acceptance: running ./tool --version prints fleet-e2e-toy v1.0.0, exit code 0, works alongside other flags.

title: [impl] delete subcommand (--id)
acceptance_criteria: src/cli.ts handles: cli delete --id <id>. Requires --id. Issues DELETE /api/notes/:id; on 204 prints a confirmation object (e.g. { "deleted": <id> }) to stdout and exits 0. Non-2xx (incl 404) prints { error } to stderr and exits 1. Uses the shared HTTP client.

title: [impl] update subcommand (--id, optional --title/--content/--tags)
acceptance_criteria: src/cli.ts handles: cli update --id <id> [--title <t>] [--content <c>] [--tags <csv>]. Requires --id. Only includes provided fields in the PUT /api/notes/:id body (tags csv split as in create). Pretty-prints the updated note to stdout, exits 0. Non-2xx (incl 404) prints { error } to stderr and exits 1. Uses the shared HTTP client.

title: [impl] create subcommand (--title, --content, --tags)
acceptance_criteria: src/cli.ts handles: cli create --title <t> --content <c> [--tags <csv>]. Requires --title and --content. --tags is an optional comma-separated string split into a string array (empty/omitted => []). Issues POST /api/notes with a JSON body, pretty-prints the created note (201) to stdout, exits 0. Non-2xx prints { error } to stderr and exits 1. Uses the shared HTTP client.

title: [impl] read subcommand (--id)
acceptance_criteria: src/cli.ts handles: cli read --id <id>. Requires --id (non-empty). Issues GET /api/notes/:id, pretty-prints the note JSON to stdout, exits 0. A 404 or other non-2xx prints { error } to stderr and exits 1. Uses the shared HTTP client.

title: [impl] list subcommand (--tag, --q)
acceptance_criteria: src/cli.ts handles: cli list [--tag <tag>] [--q <query>]. Issues GET /api/notes forwarding tag and q as query params only when provided. Pretty-prints the returned JSON array to stdout and exits 0 on success. On API/network error, prints { error } to stderr and exits 1. Uses the shared HTTP client from the foundation task.

title: Add config file support (~/.fleet-e2e-toy.yaml)
description: Allow users to persist default flag values in a YAML config file at ~/.fleet-e2e-toy.yaml so they don't have to repeat common flags on every run. Acceptance: reads config on startup, CLI flags override config, warns on unknown keys, documents supported keys in README.

title: Handle SIGINT gracefully (Ctrl-C)
description: The tool should catch SIGINT (Ctrl-C) and exit cleanly without a Python traceback or incomplete output. Acceptance: Ctrl-C prints 'Interrupted.' and exits with code 130, no stack trace shown, partial output files cleaned up.

title: Add JSON output mode via --json flag
description: Add a --json flag so all command output can be emitted as machine-readable JSON for scripting and CI pipelines. Acceptance: --json flag accepted on any subcommand, output is valid JSON, human-readable output is default, errors also JSON-formatted.

title: Tag filtering endpoint
description: GET /api/notes?tag=work returns only notes with that tag. Already partially implemented - needs tests.
